sourceMethods: All 128 active subnet slots and 90 October 3–4 channel briefs screened, with selected briefs read in full.

Signed-in @ShizzyUnchained X searches included current Bittensor/TAO discovery and SN116 Carbon/SN113 LongShort outliers; Carbon’s official profile and actual registration posts were read. 195 associated public account candidates sampled with 123 current post records screened. These include commentators and quoted accounts, not only official teams.
179 repository paths scanned; 27 selected commit records inspected. Primary releases, operator documents, SN78 live API and project websites checked separately.

Signed-in AlphaGap 119-row leaderboard, SubnetRadar news and material Moments, TAO Daily, TAO Media and partner sources reviewed. Full-roster market returns and current emission leaders cross-checked against editorial selection.

September 27–October 3 reports reviewed for duplication, unresolved incidents, launch gates and future events. Reposts, code changes, operator claims and completed commercial launches were distinguished.

YouTube Videos and Live tabs checked in signed-in browser and current page metadata. Latest members upload ChgsHOGC1hM remains October 2, with 526-second player duration; latest public upload and SN49 replay are already listed. No new upload or scheduled stream found.
Final overlapping pass of 14 priority public profiles through 2026-10-04T17:49:42.549Z found no newer usable posts. SN80 public completed-season page and SN120 public dashboard inspected in browser.
accessGaps: Research cutoff 2026-10-04T17:49:42.549Z; public-source snapshots were collected between 17:36 UTC and the cutoff. The overlap includes announcements after the previous October 3 cutoff. Associated-account sampling and focused signed-in searches are not exhaustive SN-number/name searches; no Grok scan is claimed.
13 repository paths returned errors; 10 account candidates yielded no usable sample. Some directory links may be stale.
Generated channel briefs are discovery sources. Team-attributed reports remain developing when the original speaker or activation was not independently checked; member-only allegations were excluded.

SN44 PPE scores and SN74 serving measurements were not independently reproduced. SN8 external revenue is a founder report; SN124’s approximately $100,000 amount comes through a team-attributed brief, while its official post confirms two contracts. Neither ledger was independently audited.

SN116 current identity is Carbon, but automated registration alerts and AlphaGap retained conflicting old labels or figures. Block 9210632 and the paired identity event are retained. Price and volume baselines crossing re-registration are not treated as Carbon trading performance; active mining and customer deployment remain unverified.

SN113’s flagged return triggered follow-up, but the member-only handover report lacks a confirmed team identity and matched chain transfer. SN26 current repository attribution remains under review; fresh code was not promoted as a confirmed live network scoring change.

SN120 sampler audit and prior reward eligibility records are operator documentation, not an independently reconstructed payment ledger or proof of learning improvement. SN78 admission is unverified and rewards remain inactive at the API observation.

SN118 reward recovery, SN44 evaluation incidents, SN11 missing rewards and SN61 grading complaints retain confirmation gaps. SN15 Race 2 recovery does not close the separately reported Race 11 pause. SN54 UAV rewards and SN114 sandbox recovery are not independently closed.

SN22 targets October 5, SN108 launch targets October 5, SN121 next competition targets October 5–6 and SN124’s conference appearance is October 7–8. SN111’s proposed burn, SN65 diligence, SN104 security-track launch, SN94 permissionless mining, SN122 dashboard and SN25 production deployment are not assumed completed.

TaoDX order execution was not tested. Subtensor release 473 was merged, with mainnet activation unconfirmed. The TAOApp wallet website returned 403 to a public fetch; its tutorial announcement was not used to claim a tested wallet release.

decisions.reason: The apparent 136.809771% 24-hour and 118.817582% seven-day alpha/TAO moves cross the previous slot history. Registration at block 9210632 and the rename to Carbon are covered; no organic Carbon return, trading launch or negative reset-volume figure is claimed.

The 22.845247% 24-hour alpha/TAO move was checked against current sources and a focused signed-in SN113/LongShort search. The slot-handover brief contains member-only claims with no confirmed team, matched completed ownership transfer or verified fresh product launch; price alone does not establish a catalyst.

editorialDecisions: SN44 earns four stars for the PPE task milestone. The score is a team measurement, not safety certification. Its warmup and zero-score incident remains separate and developing; next-week averaging changes are not active. SN8 external-entity revenue is not Vanta Trading revenue or a reconciled combined buyback ledger.

SN116 registration and rename at block 9210632 are one event. Moments reports 653.02 TAO cost while a bot says 711, so a definitive registration cost is omitted. Official Carbon profile inspected, without an October 4 activation post. Pitchtensor funding was already covered. Current site identity is Carbon while AlphaGap retains for sale. Prices spanning the old registration and negative reset volume are not Carbon trading performance.

SN124 official post confirms two contracts; approximately $100,000 comes from a team-attributed brief, not inspected receipts. Pipeline prospects are not signed contracts. October 7–8 is a future appearance, and buybacks remain dependent on deployed value.

SN120 epoch nine exact-sampler audits follow earlier revealed weights. Nine jobs and 15 audited batches at 17:17 UTC do not establish final scores, new training or new-contract rewards. The prior-contract 86-recipient readback at block 9208448 is operator evidence, not independently reconstructed payments. No convergence claim or private operator details published.

SN11 final code preserves the $1 SPEC 26 cap and sets SPEC 27 to $0.30; the final per-spec rules supersede intermediate global-cap changes. v0.7.4 and default weight-only mode checked. Epoch 4005 and UID 74 are secondary rollout details, not proof of every validator activating or the missing-reward incident closing.

SN74 v0.6.20 was published at 17:33 UTC. Qwen3.6 RTX 5090 concurrency gains are scoped measurements; vLLM remains faster in the higher-concurrency cells. Invalid-token requests receive 400 instead of disrupting the server. No released binary was executed.

SN51 keeps existing rented pods verified while bans still prevent new rentals. SN81 code-v2 capacity is a secondary live report; agentic preparation and dormant science do not establish new paying jobs. SN78 API remains at 203 submissions but now says admission false/unverified and rewards inactive. Certified enrollment and work claims do not promise payment.

SN118 bounded artifact retries and completed-score replay are fresh code; broader reward recovery remains unconfirmed. SN71 final zero-call host retry is bounded by frozen inputs and deadline. Slot-limit removal remains proposed. The brief’s October 5 reference is not treated as a completed future incident.

SN105 caching permission is a new team-attributed policy report. Replacing mock transfers with real clients remains prospective. Named-miner allegations and inferred profit are excluded. SN25 paired 550,000-alpha reduction and 463,035-alpha addition at block 9210497 are not sales or proven fresh buys. Qualification deadlines do not imply production deployment.

SN15 Race 2 recovery and team fairness findings do not close Race 11 or confirm payouts. SN9 Redis recovery is developing; its permanent fix is staged and SDK remains a preview. SN34 leaderboard concern is an investigation, not settled misconduct. SN23 judging procedure and SN94 mining consultation do not establish completed repairs or permissionless activation.

Current top 12 emission recipients: SN51, SN64, SN4, SN120, SN107, SN44, SN53, SN8, SN3, SN80, SN15 and SN9. SN51, SN120, SN44, SN8, SN80, SN15 and SN9 are covered. SN64 Kappa results were already October 3; SN4 cloud/B300 and SN53 production partnership were previously covered; SN107 Q&A is not a new release; SN3 community tokenizer posts lack a new confirmed team milestone. SN38 ChronoLLM market and AlphaGap checked, without a newly supported revenue or training completion story.

SN80 Shift and simulation results are not new launches. A late-found completed physical-robot competition is newly covered with its actual September 27 end date: champion 10/70 formal runs, two qualified entries, recordings and an operator-reported unlock ledger. The 1,740 alpha shown paid by October 4 is not an independent chain reconstruction. Existing 0.5 TAO fee proposal is not assumed applied; current real-track fee is separately displayed as 1.5 TAO. No historical edition changed.

SN113 flagged 24-hour move lacks a confirmed handover team and matched chain event. SN26 identity/repository attribution uncertainty prevents a fresh live scoring claim. SN103 metadata removals do not prove a validator exit. Small SN17 locks and a 301 TAO SN51 wallet movement lack standalone business materiality; no motive inferred.

SN111 planned 90% miner burn is not assumed active. SN108 targets October 5; SN121 targets October 5–6; SN65 remains in diligence; SN104 mainnet and SN114 recovery remain unverified. SN122 dashboard and future Gamma integration are not completed releases. SN100 TestFlight and SN90 leak-fix claims remain member-only. SN55 interview is not a fresh product launch; SN17 match matrices do not prove a new round began or winners were paid.

Member-only allegations about SN20, SN60, SN95 and SN125 are excluded. SN13’s single failure statistic is not generalized; SN97 fairness opinions are not official rule changes. SN46 benchmarks lack primary workload verification; no repeated universal performance comparison. SN45 version-only update and relevance-review report are below the standalone material threshold.

Unrelated StonkFun holder counts, platform revenue and SHIB pairs are excluded, along with unrelated crypto, politics and price hype. Associated partner accounts were checked without claiming exhaustive coverage. No five-star threshold met. September 27 automated X-post permission does not apply today; no X post made.

Both signed-in YouTube Videos and Live tabs and current metadata show no new upload or upcoming stream. October 2 member ChgsHOGC1hM remains 526 seconds (8:46 player versus 8:47 thumbnail). Latest public TmGJBuSoqrI and SN49 replay NAbCyYwZ_5w are already listed. Removed Shiz Cat, VUNE and Cascade IDs remain absent; no video component edit needed.

Final overlapping public-profile pass checked 14 priority source accounts through 2026-10-04T17:49:42.549Z, with no newer usable post found. The guessed chrono_llm alias returned 404 and is recorded as unavailable, not claimed as an official account search; the initial roster-associated ChronoLLM sample and AlphaGap were separately checked.
